critical_code_review_comments: crossborder.py router POST /plan/crossborder/save takes household_id as query param (not path/body) — fine, but inconsistent with some other routers that embed it in the body; low priority.

Education.jsx: local useState for children means navigating away and back resets to 1 child; this is OK since 'Save as goals' persists to /api/goals, but if an advisor expects the UI to remember the last projection they'll be confused. Consider persisting last run per household in localStorage (nice-to-have).
The 'cb-save' button is hidden only for enterprise tier (`user.tier !== 'enterprise'`). This is intentional per spec — enterprise read-only.
STATE_FLAT uses 2024 top-marginal rates as a simplification; the note explicitly says 'Simplified at top marginal X%' which is honest. OR=9.9%, GA=5.39%, CO=4.4%, TX=0 — all behaved as expected.
